name: Desk recovery
description: After-work undoing of the chair. 5 poses, 30 s each.

poses.name: Neck circles
poses.notes: Slow half-circles, ear toward shoulder, chin to chest. Reverse direction halfway.

poses.name: Doorway chest stretch
poses.notes: Forearm against a wall, gently rotate the torso away. Switch sides at 15 s.

poses.name: Standing side bend
poses.notes: Reach one arm overhead, lean to the opposite side. Lengthen the obliques.

poses.name: Hip flexor lunge
poses.notes: Sunken hips, back knee down. Switch sides at 15 s. Counteracts the chair.

poses.name: Supine spinal twist
poses.notes: On your back, drop both knees to one side, gaze the other way. Switch at 15 s.
